title: Quantity on a Coverage-Billed Disposable Filter Line (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
## Billing rule

A coverage-billed line of disposable filters (A7038) under the PAP Supply Replenishment Program ships one month of filters at one disposable filter a month, so the line carries one filter.

The units on the line are the months shipped multiplied by the filters per month, a whole number. For a coverage-billed disposable-filter line booked under this rule, and only for such a line, the line covers the months shipped, counted from the ship date, and its covered-through date is the day before the same day of the month that many months later.

## The figures

| Element | Figure |
|---|---|
| months the line covers | 1 |
| filters per month | 1 |
| units on the line | 1 multiplied by 1, which is 1 |
| covered-through date | the day before the same day of the month 1 month after the ship date |

## Worked example (hypothetical dates)

A line ships on 14 March. It covers 1 month, so its covered-through date is the day before 14 April: 13 April. It carries 1 multiplied by 1, which is 1 disposable filter.

A line shipping on 2 November covers through 1 December and carries 1 filter.
